reviewed.description: Paths of the files that were actually read and analysed

blocked_commands.description: Commands you could not run (rejected by the execution policy or the environment). An empty list means everything you needed to run did run

skipped.description: What you deliberately did not look at, and why

unverified.description: Claims you could not confirm against the code

findings.description: An empty list is a legitimate answer: it means you have no objections

file.description: Path to the file; null if the finding is not tied to one (for example, missing tests)

line.description: Line number; null where there are no lines (a layout, a spreadsheet, an image) or the finding is not tied to a line

locator.description: A precise pointer where no line number exists: page, slide, cell, layer, timecode, item number, quotation. null if file+line is enough

confidence.description: certain = reproducible from the code; hypothesis = needs checking

claim.description: What exactly will break, in one sentence

why.description: The mechanism of the failure: input, state, outcome

check.description: How to verify this claim in under a minute

verdict.description: ok = no objections; fix-required = something must be fixed before delivery; rework = it needs redoing substantively. Neutral to the kind of work: applies to code as well as to prose, layouts and estimates
